title: Components and cladding.
officialText:
Net design wind pressures, p , for the components and cladding of buildings
net
represent the net pressures (sum of internal and external) to be applied normal to each building surface as shown in Figure
1609.6.2.2. The net design wind pressure, p , shall be determined from Equation 16-44:
net
pnet = λIp (Equation 16-44)
net30
where:
λ = Adjustments factor for building height and exposure from Table 1609.6.2.1(4).
I = Importance factor as defined in Section 1609.5.
Pnet30 = Net design wind pressure for Exposure B, at h =30 feet (9144 mm), and for I =1.0, from Tables 1609.6.2.1(2) and
w
1609.6.2.1(3).
